background.text: Horse and Rider is a beeswax sculpture created 1508, 1511 depicting a rider on a horse. The history of the sculpture is unknown before the 20th century. The work has been attributed to Leonardo da Vinci by the Italian art historian Carlo Pedretti, though most other art historians disagree with the attribution.
